rules: canonical end = open + tf; raw close fields map to the same end (archive -1 us, REST -1 ms)
feature uses bar b only if end(b) + delta_avail <= t_issue; late arrivals never back-filled
path-extreme labels: bars with open >= t_act; close-based labels: closes with end > t_act
fitted quantities use only bars available before their month / fold start
freeze: hard failure in features and labels

items: A1 ledger registration before run; spec hashes bound
A6 censoring/null counts per segment x scope
A7 leak canaries (label time-shift, shuffled features, feature delay, trip-wire ceiling from v1.1)

B1.multiplicity: Holm within task (m<=2); Bonferroni x3 across tasks
B1.test: one-sided Brier-loss differential vs strongest dev-selected baseline; p = max(stationary block bootstrap 2000, Diebold-Mariano HAC fixed-b)

B.B3: Cox slope CI contains 1, intercept CI contains 0, calibration-in-the-large CI contains 1
B.B4: dev-fold sign consistency >= 2/3; per scope; T3 both vol states
B.B6: W2 S-MAJ: BSS point >= 0 and slope CI contains 1 else FRAGILE
B.class: statistical thresholds (gate HISTORICAL_LOCKED_SKILL per task x scope); structure frozen, CDP from v1.1

folds.eligibility: decision_time <= fold_start - embargo AND label_end <= fold_start; evaluation rows censored when the label crosses the fold end

status: FROZEN definitions; calibration-dependent parameters (CDP) provisional until MI-C v1.1 (Phase 1S, derivation map)

candidates: M2 shallow GBM (<=200 trees, depth<=3, <=3-point grid on dev)
T1.label: D24 = 1 if min(low of 15m bars with open in [T+15min, T+15min+24h)) <= p0 x (1 - 0.06); secondary D4: 3 % over [T+15min, T+4h15min)
T1.name: downside-risk probability
T1.reference: p0 = decision-bar close (REFERENCE price, not an executable entry price; executable-entry risk not modelled)

T2.event: close_t > L and close_t - L >= 0.25 x ATR14(4h, through t); no new event for the symbol within 6 bars
T2.label: FB = 1 if any close of bars t+1..t+6 with end > t_act is <= L; the breakout close is never a label
T2.level: L = max high of the 20 bars before t
T2.name: false-breakout probability

T3.name: BTC regime identification and transition
T3.regime: trend z30 = ln(C_d/C_{d-30})/(sigma60 x sqrt 30): up >= +0.5, down <= -0.5, else range; vol high if sigma20 >= 1.25 x trailing-365d median (expanding before 365 d); 6 states

universe.exploratory: S-ALT = PIT top-30 USDT by trailing-30d median quote volume, monthly, >= 200 1d bars, stablecoin / leveraged bases excluded, delisted kept to last bar; EXPLORATORY_ONLY ceiling (DS-3)
universe.universe_features: allowed in S-MAJ models only with the DS-7 without-variant and FRAGILE cap

utility.U1: exposure 1 - 0.5 x 1[p > q80_dev] vs matched-mean-exposure vol targeting; fee 2x10 bps, +20 bps stress; CVaR95, maxDD, Sharpe, turnover
utility.U2: net 24h forward reference return by predicted-FB quintile
utility.label: REFERENCE_PRICE_COUNTERFACTUAL
